newsitem.title: USA: PerSeptive stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: PerSeptive stake held by investor.

text.p: Garo Armen, a New York investor, said Monday he holds a 5.7 percent stake in PerSeptive Biosystems Inc, or 1,221,321 shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Armen said his latest transactions included a net 204,664 shares brought between January 14 and February 13 at prices ranging from $5.87 to $7.17 per share.
PerSeptive, based in Framingham, Mass., designs, manufactures and markets proprietary products and systems for the purification and analysis of biomolecules.
